en: A black‑and‑white vintage photograph of a young men's basketball team posing outdoors beneath a simple wooden backboard with a netted hoop. Six players are arranged in two rows in front of trees; three stand with arms crossed, while three are crouched or seated on the ground, one holding a basketball marked with a large letter. In the upper left corner, stylized printed text in Cyrillic indicates the year 1925 and describes the team.
